raw_note: Friday fish fry confirmed (Facebook post 'Serving our Full Menu & Fish Fry All Day' and WPR Lenten Fish Fry Guide listing), but no accessible source names the species. Also known for gluten-free pizzas.

Friday fish fry confirmed by Travel Wisconsin listing, but species never named. A customer tip asked them to ADD perch, implying perch is not currently served. Former domain arrowsportsclub.com is now parked/for sale.
Friday-only fish fry: baked or fried Alaskan cod or haddock, $16 with potato, $19 with salad. Friday dinner 5-9 pm.

Friday Fish Fry served with coleslaw, rye bread, choice of potato: butterflied shrimp and haddock, pan-fried walleye, breaded shrimp basket, haddock soft-shell fish tacos. Menu PDF on bbjacks.com is indexed but the server refused direct fetch; details from search-indexed menu content, dated ~2020.
Aggregator listings (menupix, visitwausau) say the restaurant 'offers Fish Fry' and is open Fridays to 8 pm, but no source names a species. Primarily a breakfast/brunch spot.

Own menu: Friday pan-fried haddock, half portion $12.50, whole $13.75, 1.5 order $17.75, double $21.75; choice of baked potato, hash browns, spaghetti, or fettuccine Alfredo plus coleslaw. Online ordering offered. Voted best fish fry in Wausau-area polls.

Read their dinner menu PDF directly: Pan Fried Canadian Walleye $28 and 'Shore Lunch' Canadian walleye sandwich $18; also chili-glazed salmon $24 (unmapped species). Menu does not label a dedicated Friday fish fry, though aggregators list one.

WiscoBars listing: Friday fish fry with walleye, lightly breaded cod, and garlic shrimp skewers; visitwausau adds baked 'poor man's' cod option. Fish Fry Friday confirmed on their Facebook, served until 9 pm. Tied 6th in WPR 2026 readers' poll.

IMPORTANT: this venue has been renamed Prost Hill Bar & Grill LLC (same County Rd N Ringle address and phone; a newer 'Hillside Pub' Facebook page may indicate another rename). Menu favorites: Beer Battered Haddock 2-pc meal and Fresh Water Walleye Bites; Friday fish fry with fries and potato salad.
Now operating as 'Chacks Day Break Bar & Grill'. Reviews confirm a Friday night fish fry and Friday fish tacos, but no source names the species. Primarily a breakfast/lunch spot.

Own site (Fast Lane Cafe) has a dedicated 'Friday Fish Fry Menus' section, but the menus are posted only as images that could not be read as text; no species named in any text source. Reviews call the fish fry excellent.
Fish Fry Friday features baked or fried haddock and shrimp with tartar sauce; starts 6 pm Fridays. Shrimp portions repeatedly praised in reviews. Neighborhood tavern since 1936.

Friday fish fry 11 am-9 pm. Indexed menu from the club's own friday-fish-fry page lists haddock, perch, walleye (plate and sandwich), jumbo tiger shrimp, haddock sandwich, combo (2 pc haddock + 4 pc shrimp), plus 'poor man's lobster' (base species unstated), breaded scallops, and frog legs (unmapped). Site itself was unreachable at research time (DNS timeout); perch corroborated by a restaurantji review.
Friday fish fry confirmed but no source names the species. Breakfast/brunch cafe.
Species from customer reviews only, no published menu: perch 'best he has had in the area', shrimp 'big & excellent'.
Reviews: 'biggest piece of walleye'; 21-shrimp baskets. Haddock mention unverified.
'Fish Friday' advertised and praised, but no source names the species.

Online ordering menu: 2 Piece Haddock $16.95 (most popular) and Haddock & Jumbo Shrimp Combo. Caution: cod/perch/walleye references online belong to the predecessor Hiawatha Restaurant & Lounge, closed Sept 2022. Own domain is parked, so no website listed.
Fish fry menu: haddock fillet $16.99; Poorman's Lobster (Icelandic cod) $19.99; Canadian walleye $23.99; Lake Superior perch $22.99; shrimp basket $19.99.
Friday specials (own menu PDF, 12pm-9pm): Canadian walleye, beer-battered haddock 2pc/3pc, tiger shrimp, combos, clam fry, poor man's lobster. PDF prints no prices; carryout allowed with surcharge.
Now operating as 'Homestead on 52'. Own site confirms Friday fish fry 2pm-8pm but names no species; aggregated menus list Cajun cod and walleye.
Review cites perch dinners; prices 'at the low end of the fish fry scale'. Haddock/cod mentions unverified. Fast takeout noted.
Weekly fish fry confirmed via own Facebook, but no source names the species.

Own Friday menu: walleye $19.99; Romano-encrusted cod $18.99; perch $14.99; bluegill $14.99; shrimp $14.99-$19.99; salmon outside allowed list. AYCE tempura smelt cited in reviews as recurring special.
Syndicated menu: cod 2pc $10 - 4pc $17; walleye $17; perch $14; jumbo shrimp $14-$19.50; combos to $22. Voted Best Fish Fry ~15 years; to-go by phone.
Reviews cite hand-breaded cod at the Friday fry; walleye bites are an any-day menu item, not confirmed as part of the fry.
Friday fish fry confirmed via reviews but no source states the species; chain menu has no fish fry items. Likely dine-in Friday special.
Friday fish fry is an off-menu special. Reviews cite fried cod and Friday perch dinner; coleslaw, potato salad, fries, rye. Call ahead for carryouts.
Fish fry confirmed via reviews but species never stated; Friday special not published online.
Freshly Battered Cod Fish Fry customer favorite; fish $10, 8 large shrimp $15. $1/order to-go charge. Facebook only.
Friday Fish menu: beer battered haddock $10.50-$14; baked or pan fried options; battered shrimp $17; crispy walleye bites $14. Opened Jan 2025.
Freshly Battered Cod $9.99-$11.99; Baked Cod $12.99. Twice-baked potato or fries, coleslaw, rye. Call for takeout.
Friday Fish Fry $10.99 haddock (battered, broiled, or Italian-crumb breaded); fish & chips $15.99; Canadian walleye $16.99/$21.99. Menu may be stale - venue points to Facebook for current.
2026 menu: beer battered walleye bites fish & chips $15; shrimp baskets $12-$18. Friday fry features 'a new catch every single month' - rotating species. Curbside pickup.
Friday menu: haddock $13.50-$19.50; walleye $19.99; shrimp $25.75; Poorman's/Baked $15.50. AYCE is Thursday wings only, not fish.
Friday menu: North Atlantic cod battered or grilled $9-$19; shrimp $14. Fries or potato salad, coleslaw, rye, tartar.
Fish Fry with Shrimp and Fish & Shrimp Combo are customer favorites; fried-fish species never stated in any accessible source. Facebook only.
Friday Fish Fry Specials: Pacific Cod $14-$20; 6pc shrimp $17; Fridays 11am-9pm. Walleye entree on regular menu (not the fry).
Fish Fry Menu PDF: Perch Plate $17.99; Perch Sandwich $14.99; Cod Plate $14.99/$16.99 (broiled available); cod Baja tacos $14.99; shrimp $10.99-$11.99. Delivery & carry out.
Reviews cite a traditional Friday fish fry and a walleye fish fry; fried fish sandwich also mentioned, species unstated. No own website found.
Venue's own Facebook post: perch walleye haddock fish tacos; website menu lists 10-12 oz Canadian walleye and lake perch dinners with coleslaw, tartar, lemon & rye.
Official menu PDF: 2pc/3pc haddock beer battered or baked $12/$14, 4pc lightly breaded perch $15, 2pc pan-fried walleye $16, 5pc shrimp dinner $19, mix & match $20; all with coleslaw and rye.
Review: battered walleye Friday fish fry; jumbo shrimp also mentioned (unverified). No own website; active Facebook page.
Friday Fish menu lists panko-breaded walleye, 6-pc shrimp, and beer-battered pollock fish & chips - pollock not in allowed list. Curry walleye also on dinner menu.
Menu: Fish Fry comes with 2 beer batter haddock, coleslaw, and homemade potato salad. Aggregator claims of cod/walleye/perch/bluegill appear AI-generated and are excluded.
Own menu Friday specials: beer-battered Icelandic cod $11.49, smelt fry $10.99, 2pc haddock $13.49, 6pc shrimp $15.99, combos; catfish $15.99 not in allowed list.
Haddock Fish Fry with coleslaw, rye, choice of side; venue site advertises Friday fish fry but publishes no menu online.
Own menu: haddock deep fried or baked, combination platter of perch, haddock, shrimp and scallops - scallops not in allowed list.
Official menu Friday specials: beer-battered cod 1-4pc $10.99-$13.99, Poorman's baked cod $15.99, 8pc shrimp $17.99; after 4pm pan-fried cod $15.99, pan-fried walleye $17.99.
Official menu, fish fry all day 11am-10pm: 2pc haddock $15, 2pc butterflied perch $18, 6 jumbo shrimp $17, coconut shrimp $21.
Serves a fish fry per multiple listings, but menu is image-only; no source names a species.
Official menu, fish fry daily 11am-9pm: pollock fry $7.25-$10.50 (pollock not in allowed list); perch 3pc $12.75 / 4pc $15.75; haddock 2pc $11 / 3pc $13; shrimp $11.50; combos $12-$14.
Friday Walleye Dinner listed under customers' favorites; seafood combo also praised, contents unstated. No own website; Facebook is primary presence.
